newsitem.title: USA: Toyota aims to double oper profits - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Toyota aims to double oper profits - WSJ.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said it aims to nearly double its operating profits in the next few years, the Wall Street Journal reported.

The paper said in its electronic edition on Tuesday that the Japanese auto maker has been telling analysts in the U.S and Europe that by early next century it intends to raise its operating profit margin to 9.0 percent of sales.
In the year ended March 31, Toyota's profit margin was 5.4 percent of sales.
According to analysts interviewed by the paper, Toyota's goal is roughly equal to targets set by the U.S. Big Three auto makers to earn net income equal to 5.0 percent of sales.
Toyota is talking publicly about such matters because it is preparing to seek a listing on the New York Stock Exchange, the paper said it was told by company officials.
